audit_metadata.audit_name: Final Dataset Integrity, Reproducibility and Documentation Audit
audit_metadata.auditor_role: Senior ML4SE Research Engineer and Independent Academic Auditor

humanizer_291_vs_178.root_cause_of_discrepancy: An agent mistakenly doubled the threshold TP count (TP=89 at threshold 0.60 -> 89*2=178) in expansion planning documents. 178 is unverified and incorrect. Authoritative count is 291 in Dataset 1.

mediatr_91_vs_105.root_cause_of_discrepancy: An agent estimated 52 positive + 53 clean = 105 in expansion planning documents. 105 is unverified and incorrect. Authoritative count is 91 in Dataset 1.

fluentvalidation_34_vs_28.root_cause_of_discrepancy: v1 pilot allowed 3 test fixture methods to enter Label 1 (src/FluentValidation.Tests/ChainedValidationTester.cs and TestExtensions.cs) due to incomplete regex coverage on nested projects, and sampled 17 clean methods (total 34). v2 pilot corrected this using src/utils/source_classifier.py, purging the 3 test fixtures (leaving 14 production positive methods) and resampling exactly 14 clean methods (total 28 observations). FluentValidation is not in Dataset 1.

fluentvalidation_v2_audit.false_positive_commit_description: Packaging compatibility overload (issue #1860); modified 0 C# source lines, produced 0 SZZ traces and 0 observations.

machine_learning_methodology_audit.five_fold_cv_claim_status: Strictly disallowed until 5 distinct training repos are collected and evaluated
machine_learning_methodology_audit.in_fold_preprocessing_details: Imputation, constant removal, and scaling fitted strictly on fold training data
machine_learning_methodology_audit.holdout_quarantine_status: Previously inspected by researcher; serves as diagnostic benchmark, not blind gold standard
machine_learning_methodology_audit.decision_threshold_optimization: Tuned on pooled out-of-fold CV predictions; exhibits post-selection optimism on CV F1
machine_learning_methodology_audit.brier_score_interpretation: Measures mean squared error in predicted probabilities; lowest Brier score in CV was 0.1983 (rf_deep_unconstrained) and 0.2283 (logistic_regression), whereas best F1 model had Brier 0.2317 in CV and 0.2627 on holdout
machine_learning_methodology_audit.class_balance_impact: Candidate-clean methods sampled 1:1 against positive methods (~50% prevalence); operational precision in low-prevalence production (5%-15%) will be lower via Bayes rule

model_families_claim.authoritative_value: DummyClassifier, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest

repository_aware_validation_claim.authoritative_value: GroupShuffleSplit for holdout, 2-fold GroupKFold for training CV

conditions: Do not start collection until authoritative counts are reconciled in all documents.
Maintain strict separation between Dataset 1 (483) and future expansion snapshots.
Acknowledge that 5-fold CV is a future capability requiring 5 training repositories.
Preserve independent quarantine for holdout repository.
